title: Image edits can use multiple references
summary:
Image edits gained multiple references, authentication setup got clearer, and request queues became more consistent.

The image API accepts comma-separated URLs in the `image` parameter, and Azure GPT Image edit mode now uses every supplied reference image rather than only the first.

The auth dashboard gained a collapsible guide and clearer examples for web and backend apps. Token input formats were narrowed to the documented URL, header and body fields; older API-key aliases are no longer accepted.

DreamHer was added to the site's Creative & Interactive Applications list and the README. It turns answers to ten questions into a generated image.

highlights.title: Edit with multiple images
highlights.text: Pass comma-separated URLs in the `image` parameter to use multiple reference images with Azure GPT Image edit mode. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: A clearer auth guide
highlights.text: The auth dashboard now has a collapsible guide to tokens and trusted domains, with examples for web and backend apps. [Open the dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
